title: Sixteen is old enough to vote

defects.quote: its third reading by 431 votes to 102
defects.correction: The Commons passed the Representation of the People Bill at third reading on 2 September 2026 by 411 votes to 102.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] True value: 411 ayes to 102 noes (Division No. 64). The date is right; only the number of ayes is wrong. Source: https://www.beyondthevote.co.uk/division/2416

defects.correction: The 2005 private member's bill from Stephen Williams was defeated by 136 votes to 128.

defects.quote: Malta's parliament voted unanimously for the same change in March 2016
defects.correction: The Maltese parliament voted unanimously on 5 March 2018 to lower the voting age to 16 for general elections, making Malta the second EU member state to do so.
defects.note: [needs-source] [multi-part] True value: March 2018. The first half of the sentence (Austria in 2007, the first EU member) is true. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voting_age

defects.quote: an Act that received royal assent on 15 January 2021
defects.correction: The Senedd and Elections (Wales) Act 2020 received royal assent on 15 January 2020.
defects.note: [needs-source] True value: 15 January 2020 (the franchise was first used at the 2021 Senedd election, which makes 2021 a plausible near-miss). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senedd_and_Elections_(Wales)_Act_2020

defects.quote: Young people who vote at sixteen are twice as likely to still be voting at thirty.
Sixteen-year-olds can work and pay tax, so nobody can honestly object to them voting.
defects.known_rebuttal: Paying tax has never been the test for the vote: children of any age pay VAT and can pay income tax on earnings, and adults who pay no tax keep the vote. The law also treats sixteen as short of full adulthood in most other respects. In England a young person must stay in education or training until 18, the minimum age for marriage in England and Wales has been 18 since 2023, and sixteen-year-olds cannot buy alcohol or serve on a jury. An honest objection is therefore available: the voting age should match the age at which the law grants the other rights of adulthood.

defects.quote: Every one is degraded, whether aware of it or not, when other people, without consulting him, take upon themselves unlimited power to regulate his destiny.
defects.source_title: Considerations on Representative Government by John Stuart Mill

defects.note: [needs-source] True: the reasoned amendment was defeated by 410 votes to 105 on 2 March 2026 (Division No. 435). Source: https://www.beyondthevote.co.uk/division/2267

defects.quote: the House of Keys approved the change by 19 votes to 4
defects.note: [needs-source] True: the Isle of Man lowered its voting age to 16 in 2006, the House of Keys approving by 19 votes to 4. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voting_age
